sessionStart.powershell: $root = Join-Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.copilot') 'installed-plugins'; $scripts = @(); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root -PathType Container) { $scripts = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path (Join-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName 'ai-attribution') 'scripts') 'emit-policy.ps1' } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf } | Sort-Object) }; if ($scripts.Count -eq 1) { $p = Get-Command pwsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { & $p.Source -NoProfile -File $scripts[0] } else { powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $scripts[0] } } else { $reason = if ($scripts.Count -eq 0) { 'missing' } else { 'ambiguous' }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[ai-attribution] hook script is $reason; no policy context emitted"); [Console]::Out.Write('{}') }
sessionStart.bash: scripts=(); for s in "$HOME"/.copilot/installed-plugins/*/ai-attribution/scripts/emit-policy.sh; do [ -f "$s" ] && scripts+=("$s"); done; if [ "${#scripts[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then bash "${scripts[0]}"; else if [ "${#scripts[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then reason=missing; else reason=ambiguous; fi; printf '%s\n' "[ai-attribution] hook script is $reason; no policy context emitted" >&2; printf '{}'; fi
